Strong understanding of web applications, HTML, Java Script, CSS, and j Query (mandatory). Proven experience supporting B2B Saa S customers in a technical support environment. title: Tech Lead – Commerce Platform

You'll lead the design of scalable distributed systems, mentor engineers, establish engineering standards, and work closely with Product and Engineering leadership to build a platform capable of serving large-scale commerce workloads. In 2026, Wingify merged with AB Tasty, creating one of the world’s largest independent experimentation and personalization platforms. Today, the combined entity: Generates $100M+ in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) Serves 4,000+ customers globally Has 800+ employees across North America, Europe, and APAC Operates from 11 global offices Is valued at approximately $400–500M About the Commerce Team The Commerce (Recommendations & Merchandising) team builds the intelligence layer powering modern e-commerce experiences. Our platform enables personalized recommendations, merchandising automation, intelligent search, and large-scale data processing that directly influence how users discover and purchase products. Our engineering stack includes: Python & Go microservices React & Type Script Google Cloud Platform Airflow dbt / Dataform Big Query Click House Kubernetes You'll help evolve this platform while solving challenging problems in distributed systems, search, scalability, and data engineering. Design highly scalable, reliable, and performant distributed systems. Lead architecture discussions, design reviews, and code reviews across the engineering team. Establish engineering best practices for system design, testing, CI/CD, observability, and operational excellence. Break complex initiatives into executable technical roadmaps while proactively managing technical risks and debt. Mentor senior and mid-level engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning. Partner with Product Managers and the Engineering Manager to make pragmatic technical trade-offs and execute the product roadmap. Stay close to the code by building critical components, prototyping new ideas, and leading production incident resolution when required. What We're Looking For Required 6–8 years of software engineering experience with a strong track record of designing and building large-scale distributed systems. Proven experience leading technical initiatives and influencing engineering direction. Strong expertise in Python or Go , with working knowledge of the other language. Deep understanding of API design using REST and/or Graph QL. Strong foundation in distributed systems, system design, scalability, and performance optimization. Experience working with analytical databases such as Click House, Big Query, Snowflake, or Redshift. Experience with modern search technologies such as Meilisearch, Elasticsearch, Open Search, Solr, or Vespa. Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure), Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, and observability tooling. Familiarity with modern data engineering practices using Airflow, dbt, Dataform, or equivalent technologies. Excellent communication, mentoring, and technical leadership skills. Nice to Have Experience with recommendation engines, search relevance, ranking systems, or ML-powered products. Exposure to frontend technologies such as React and Type Script. Education Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline. Equivalent professional experience is equally valued. title: Senior Software Engineer - Client Services
jobDescription:
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is comfortable working with Vanilla Java Script, HTML, and CSS to build and customize frontend solutions, debug complex client-side issues using browser developer tools, and handle DOM manipulation, event handling, and dynamic UI updates. Should be confident analyzing APIs through Fetch/XHR requests, tracking DOM changes using Mutation Observer and browser console techniques, and making real-time UI modifications using inspect element and custom scripts. Key

Preventing interference from existing scripts and styles. Ensuring compatibility across devices and screen sizes. Making changes that survive dynamic DOM updates. Tracking user interactions for experiments. Key Skills Required Strong understanding of Vanilla Java Script, j Query, HTML and CSS. Advanced DOM traversal and manipulation. Event handling and debugging in live environments. Using Mutation Observers for dynamic content. Handling Single Page Applications (SPAs). Writing safe and conflict-free CSS. Understanding browser behaviour and edge cases. Performance-safe scripting on production websites. Important Mindset Difference This role is highly problem-solving oriented. Who Will Enjoy This Role Developers who love Java Script, j Query and CSS deeply. Those who enjoy solving DOM challenges. People are comfortable working without access to source code. Developers who like debugging tricky real-world issues. We don’t build websites — we intelligently manipulate the DOM using Vanilla Java Script, j Query and CSS to run experiments on live websites.
